cudnnDebug_t.doc: `cudnnDebug_t` is a structure used by `cudnnSetCallback` and `cudnnGetCallback` containing the metadata, such as time, time since start, stream ID, process and thread ID, that the user may choose to print or store in customized callbacks.

cudnnFraction_t.doc: `cudnnFraction_t` is a structure that allows a user to define `int64_t` fractions.

cudnnActivationMode_t.doc: `cudnnActivationMode_t` is an enumerated type used to select the neuron activation function used in `cudnnActivationForward`, `cudnnActivationBackward`, and `cudnnConvolutionBiasActivationForward`.

CUDNN_ACTIVATION_CLIPPED_RELU.doc: Selects the clipped rectified linear function.

CUDNN_ACTIVATION_IDENTITY.doc: Selects the identity function, intended for bypassing the activation step in `cudnnConvolutionBiasActivationForward`. (The `cudnnConvolutionBiasActivationForward` function must use `CUDNN_CONVOLUTION_FWD_ALGO_IMPLICIT_PRECOMP_GEMM`.) Does not work with `cudnnActivationForward` or `cudnnActivationBackward`.

cudnnBackendAttributeName_t.doc: `cudnnBackendAttributeName_t` is an enumerated type that indicates the backend descriptor attributes that can be set or get using `cudnnBackendSetAttribute` and `cudnnBackendGetAttribute` functions. The backend descriptor to which an attribute belongs is identified by the prefix of the attribute name.

cudnnBackendBehaviorNote_t.doc: `cudnnBackendBehaviorNote_t` is an enumerated type that indicates queryable behavior notes of an engine. Users can query for an array of behavior notes from an `CUDNN_BACKEND_ENGINE_DESCRIPTOR` using the `cudnnBackendGetAttribute` function.

cudnnBackendDescriptorType_t.doc: `cudnnBackendDescriptor_t` is an enumerated type that indicates the type of backend descriptors. Users create a backend descriptor of a particular type by passing a value from this enumerate to the `cudnnBackendCreateDescriptor` function.

CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_BLOCK_SCALE_QUANTIZE_DESCRIPTOR,
CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_BLOCK_SCALE_DEQUANTIZE_DESCRIPTOR,
CUDNN_BACKEND_DEVICEPROP_DESCRIPTOR,
CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_EXPAND_BAND_MATRIX_DESCRIPTOR,
CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_CONTRACT_BAND_MATRIX_DESCRIPTOR,
CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_SDPA_FWD_DESCRIPTOR,
CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_MOE_GROUPED_MATMUL_DESCRIPTOR,
CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_SDPA_BWD_DESCRIPTOR,
CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_DIAGONAL_BAND_MASK_DESCRIPTOR,
CUDNN_BACKEND_OPERATION_SOFTMAX_DESCRIPTOR,
} cudnnBackendDescriptorType_t;

cudnnBackendHeurMode_t.doc: `cudnnBackendHeurMode_t` is an enumerated type that indicates the operation mode of a `CUDNN_BACKEND_ENGINEHEUR_DESCRIPTOR`.

CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_A and CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_IN.doc:
[`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_A`] provides the exact same functionality as [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_INSTANT`]. The purpose of this renaming is to better match the naming of [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_B`].

```text
Consider the use of [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_INSTANT`] as deprecated; instead, use [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_A`].

[`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_A`] utilizes a decision tree heuristic which provides optimal inference time on the CPU in comparison to [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_B`].

[`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_A`] and [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_INSTANT`] support the following operation node or operation graph:

* [ConvolutionFwd](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn//latest/developer/graph-api.html#convolutionfwd "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")
* [ConvolutionBwdFilter](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn//latest/developer/graph-api.html#convolutionbwdfilter "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")
* [ConvolutionBwdData](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn//latest/developer/graph-api.html#convolutionbwddata "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")
* [ConvBNfprop](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn//latest/developer/graph-api.html#convbnfprop "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")
* [ConvBNwgrad](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn//latest/developer/graph-api.html#convbnwgrad "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")
* [ConvBiasAct](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn//latest/developer/graph-api.html#convbiasact "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")
* [ConvScaleBiasAct](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn//latest/developer/graph-api.html#convscalebiasact "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")
* [DgradDreluBNBwdWeight](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn//latest/developer/graph-api.html#dgraddrelubnbwdweight "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")
* [Patterns supported by the runtime fusion engine](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn//latest/developer/graph-api.html#runtime-fusion-engine "(in NVIDIA cuDNN)")

All other operation graphs are not supported.
```

CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_B.doc:
Can utilize the neural net based heuristics to improve generalization performance compared to [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_INSTANT`].

In cases where the neural net is utilized, inference time on the CPU will be increased by 10-100x compared to [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_INSTANT`]. These neural net heuristics are not supported for any of the following cases:

* 3-D convolutions
* Grouped convolutions (`groupCount` larger than `1`)
* Dilated convolutions (any dilation for any spatial dimension larger than `1`)

Further, the neural net is only enabled on x86 platforms when cuDNN is run on an A100 GPU. In cases where the neural net is not supported, [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_B`] will fall back to [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_INSTANT`]. [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_B`] will also fall back to [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_INSTANT`] in cases where the overhead of [`cudnnBackendHeurMode_t::CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_B`] is projected to reduce overall network performance.

CUDNN_HEUR_MODE_FALLBACK.doc: This heuristic mode is intended to be used for finding fallback options which provide functional support (without any expectation of providing optimal GPU performance).

cudnnBackendKnobType_t.doc: `cudnnBackendKnobType_t` is an enumerated type that indicates the type of performance knobs. Performance knobs are runtime settings to an engine that will affect its performance. Users can query for an array of performance knobs and their valid value range from a `CUDNN_BACKEND_ENGINE_DESCRIPTOR` using the `cudnnBackendGetAttribute` function. Users can set the choice for each knob using the `cudnnBackendSetAttribute` function with a `CUDNN_BACKEND_KNOB_CHOICE_DESCRIPTOR`.

cudnnBackendLayoutType_t.doc: `cudnnBackendLayoutType_t` is an enumerated type that indicates queryable layout requirements of an engine. Users can query for layout requirements from a `CUDNN_BACKEND_ENGINE_DESCRIPTOR` using the `cudnnBackendGetAttribute` function.

cudnnBackendNormFwdPhase_t.doc: `cudnnBackendNormFwdPhase_t` is an enumerated type used to distinguish the inference and training phase of the normalization forward operation.

cudnnBackendNormMode_t.doc:
`cudnnBackendNormMode_t` is an enumerated type to indicate the normalization mode in the backend normalization forward and normalization backward operations.

For reference:

`CUDNN_GROUP_NORM` is not yet supported. If you try to use it, cuDNN returns a [`cudnnStatus_t::CUDNN_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR`] error.

cudnnBackendNumericalNote_t.doc: `cudnnBackendNumericalNot_t` is an enumerated type that indicates queryable numerical properties of an engine. Users can query for an array of numerical notes from an `CUDNN_BACKEND_ENGINE_DESCRIPTOR` using the `cudnnBackendGetAttribute` function.
cudnnBackendNumericalNote_t.signature:
typedef enum {
CUDNN_NUMERICAL_NOTE_TENSOR_CORE = 0,
CUDNN_NUMERICAL_NOTE_DOWN_CONVERT_INPUTS,
CUDNN_NUMERICAL_NOTE_REDUCED_PRECISION_REDUCTION,
CUDNN_NUMERICAL_NOTE_FFT,
CUDNN_NUMERICAL_NOTE_NONDETERMINISTIC,
CUDNN_NUMERICAL_NOTE_WINOGRAD,
CUDNN_NUMERICAL_NOTE_WINOGRAD_TILE_4x4,
CUDNN_NUMERICAL_NOTE_WINOGRAD_TILE_6x6,
